prompt: Implement Grover's search algorithm on 3 qubits to find the single marked basis state |101>, using EXACTLY 2 Grover iterations (the optimal count for this problem size) — the SAME target as the standard grover_3q task. Use a pure PHASE oracle with no ancilla qubit: it must flip the sign (apply a -1 phase) of |101> and leave every other basis state unchanged. Each iteration is (oracle; diffuser), where the diffuser is the standard 'inversion about the mean' operator 2|s><s| - I. Start from Hadamard on all 3 qubits, then apply 2 iterations. IMPORTANT constraint: use ONLY the gates RZ, SX (square-root-X), X, and CX. Do NOT use H, Toffoli/MCX, or any other gate directly — decompose everything (including the phase oracle and the diffuser's multi-controlled gate) into this gate set. Return the resulting 3-qubit state; no measurement.
